Sentinel1.description: The Sentinel-1 is equipped with twin polar orbiting satellites designed to provide a spatial data for environment and security warranting, global economic and business growth.

Sentinel2.description: The Sentinel-2 mission systematically acquires data over land and coastal areas in a band of latitude extending from 56° South (Isla Hornos, Cape Horn, South America) to 84° North (above Greenland).
